name: Ice Storm
summary: Pounds a Cylinder with hail that deals Bludgeoning and Cold damage and leaves Difficult Terrain.

stats.effect:
Hail falls in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {ref:glossary/cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Hailstones turn ground in the Cylinder into {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain} until the end of your next turn.
stats.higherLevels: The Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 4.
